title: The archivist of 1995
description: Your project's documentation as a 1995 homepage on a 640x480 screen; only the provider.
prompt: Build /work/1995/index.html: this project's documentation as a 1995 homepage (tables, <marquee>, an under-construction GIF you draw yourself, a visitor counter, a guestbook form that goes nowhere). Open it in a browser on the virtual 640x480 screen and take a screenshot. Bonus: a MIDI-like jingle (sox or a few lines of Python) in /work/1995/jingle.wav.
notes: Screenshots and the jingle need the media variant (sandbox-ai images recipe media --from AGENT), started with --image-variant media.
